overview: Field called from his own shop, where the shelf has had a gap for six weeks. You said the Holinshed is in daily use and in excellent health, and that the cat reads only the second volume. He let that go. Sunday is dinner, after sermon, and Jacqueline has a hen. You are to bring the comedy if the book-keeper will loose it. He will read it with the door shut, and he cannot come to hear it. The chronicle stays.

parties.name: Richard Field
parties.context: Named himself and the shop, let the cat stand, set the dinner, and asked for the comedy.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Kept the chronicle, promised the comedy, and matched his goodbye.

parties.name: Jacqueline Field
parties.context: Was named as the one with the hen, and was not on the call.

parties.name: Gib
parties.context: Was the reader of the second volume, and was not present.
